d: Job Description: Splunk SIEM Engineer / Administrator

We are looking for an experienced Splunk Engineer to administer, develop, and continuously improve our Splunk Enterprise, Enterprise Security (ES), and User Behavior Analytics (UBA) environments. You will own the platform end to end, from onboarding log sources to building detection content, and you will support regulatory audits within the Kingdom.
Deploy, configure, and manage Splunk Enterprise, including user and role management and license management.
Plan and execute upgrades and patch deployments.
Manage change control, report management, and backup and recovery.
Periodically review existing configurations and propose enhancements.
Onboard new log sources and add or remove sources as required.
Track log source health and troubleshoot sources that stop sending logs.
Develop parsing rules for non-standard logs.
Detection Engineering and Security Use Cases
Develop security use cases in Splunk Enterprise Security.
Build SIEM content, including correlation rules, reports, report templates, and queries.
Create custom correlation rules for devices based on business requirements.
Continuously review and develop use cases, dashboards, alerts, and reports.
Configure threat feeds, IoCs, Sigma rules, and advisories from regulators and globally recognized organizations.
Ingest CIM-compliant data, raw events, and HR data from the Splunk platform into UBA.
Monitor UBA health using the Splunk UBA Monitoring App, and perform backups and failovers.
Support audits conducted by regulators in the Kingdom and provide evidence from the SIEM.
Manage support tickets and coordinate with SIEM support as needed.
5+ years of hands-on experience administering Splunk Enterprise in production.
Proven experience with Splunk Enterprise Security use case and correlation rule development.
Strong SPL skills, plus experience with CIM, data models, and custom parsing (props/transforms, regex).
Experience onboarding diverse log sources and troubleshooting ingestion issues.
Working knowledge of Splunk UBA administration, backup, and failover.
Familiarity with threat intelligence integration, IoCs, and Sigma rules.
Experience supporting regulatory or compliance audits (e.g., NCA, SAMA) is highly desirable.
Splunk certifications (e.g., Splunk Certified Admin, Enterprise Security Admin, or Architect).
Security certifications such as Security+, CEH, or GCIA.
Strong documentation, change management, and ticket handling discipline.
